summary: Tenon Medical filed an 8-K reporting a September 11, 2026 inducement offer letter with one holder of Series A warrants issued August 31, 2026. The holder agreed to cash-exercise up to 572,179 existing warrants at $5.02 per share, about $2.87M gross, in exchange for new five-year Series B warrants for 858,269 shares (150% of existing) at $5.02. WallachBeth Capital received a 7% cash fee plus up to $65,000 legal reimbursement. A resale S-3 is due within 30 days. Watch dilution and registration timing risk.
